evals.prompt: ponme un bind Mod+B en niri para mostrar/ocultar la barra de noctalia, igual que el estilo de los demas binds
evals.expected_output: Edits config/niri/binds/ui.kdl following the existing convention (hotkey-overlay-title + spawn-sh 'noctalia msg bar-toggle'), validates with 'niri validate', does not touch noctalia state files

evals.prompt: instala xournalpp y declara el paquete para que metapac no lo borre despues
evals.expected_output: Adds "xournalpp" to the right metapac group toml (config/metapac/groups/apps.toml), runs 'metapac sync', does NOT just paru -S without declaring

evals.prompt: quiero empezar a gestionar la configuracion de mpv en mis dots
evals.expected_output: Creates config/mpv/ in the repo and symlinks ~/.config/mpv -> ../.arch/config/mpv (directory-level symlink like the rest); does NOT run 'stow mpv' (which would flatten files into ~/.config); verifies with a 'stow -n' dry run
